title.en: Chrysler Hemi engine is an outline for Electric Low Pressure 60 Concrete Pump, not a second table

description.en: Section titles come from Chrysler Hemi engine; the Electric Low Pressure 60 Concrete Pump figures stay the printed ones. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Electric Low Pressure 60 Concrete Pump. The published table prints Motor Power 75 kW; Theoretical Output 35 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 30 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.5 m³; Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; 13 mm Stone (H / V) 100 m / 300 m; 24 mm Stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 100; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm; Main Unit Weight 3500 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 节标题来自《Chrysler Hemi engine》，电动低压60型混凝土泵的数字仍是已印数字。邢台河北品锦机械公布电动低压60型混凝土泵。已公布参数表印有：电机功率75 kW；理论输送量35 m³/h；最大出口压力30 MPa；料斗容积0.5 m³；细石输送（水平/垂直）150 m / 350 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直）100 m / 300 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直）80 m / 240 m；液压泵Kawasaki double pump 100；外形尺寸4600 × 1700 × 1700 mm；整机重量3500 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
